purpose: Повна публічна специфікація вправ для реалізації гри; правильні відповіді збережено навмисно. Це не файл початкового видимого стану плеєра.

sources.used: normalizeWord function only; search restoration is not executed

rules.sourcePolicy: Existing shipped words, contextualLessons and exact wordLesson helpers only; no new authored or guessed English sentences.
rules.order: Dictionary source order; every stable ID occurs exactly once.

campaignRoute.legacyLearnedPolicy: reference-only; no automatic campaign completion or construction credit

normalization.apostropheAndCasePolicy: Existing helpers ignore case, normalize common apostrophes and whitespace; original stored spelling and sentence case are preserved.

orderedChecks: Every normalized input token must be in knownNormalizedVocabulary of the automatic current section pack.
At least one lesson.forms sequence must occur as contiguous normalized tokens.
Automatic success only if normalizeSentence(input) equals a normalized known example from the automatic section pack.
Otherwise a sentence made of known words requires self-check; this does not mark the word learned and the card returns automatically.
ownSentence.defaultScope: Five consecutive existing cards automatically assigned within a section; exact mandatory wordIds and known examples are listed in scopes. Advance only after all current pack cards are confirmed; complete the project only at N/N.

rules.pairPolicy: An antonym/synonym pair stays one original card ID. Both source members and all extra examples are preserved; relation categories are never mixed as recognition distractors.
rules.initialPlayerState: Before answer: neutral equal option styling, shuffled choices/tokens, no selected correct answer or success mark. Correct IDs in this specification must not be exposed as visual hints.
